name: ReadGoogleSheetRange
label: Read Google Sheet Range
description: Reads data from a specified range in a Google Sheet using the Sheets API.

fields.name: SheetsService
fields.label: Sheets Service
fields.description: The authenticated SheetsService instance (from 'Create Google Sheets Service Instance' activity).

fields.name: SpreadsheetId
fields.label: Spreadsheet ID
fields.description: The ID of the Google Spreadsheet (from the URL: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/{spreadsheetId}/edit).

fields.name: SheetName
fields.label: Sheet Name
fields.description: The name of the sheet tab (e.g., 'Sheet1', 'Data').

fields.name: Range
fields.label: Range
fields.description: The cell range to read (e.g., 'A1:B10'). Use empty string or 'A1' for full column detection.

fields.name: RunDelay
fields.label: Run Delay (ms)
fields.description: Optional delay in milliseconds before executing the request. Helps avoid rate limits.

fields.name: ReadData
fields.label: Read Data
fields.description: The 2D list of values read from the sheet (IList<IList<object>>). Each inner list is a row.
